evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R², the JU transmits a J7.2 Correlation message with Response Value (RV) set to 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), sets the Source TN as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN, ceases reporting the track, and transmits a J7.0 Drop Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This details the specific coordination action taken when the local unit has responsibility (R²) for a correlated track, effectively filtering the redundant track.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the Track Numbers (TNs) are different, the JU transmits a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message with the Source TN as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the coordination logic when a remote unit holds responsibility, ensuring the correct track is retained in the network.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are the same, the receiving JU accepts the PPLI information into its database and disregards the J3 surveillance data on that track, unless the Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is 0, in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message is discarded.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the data fusion rule for identical tracks, prioritizing PPLI data over surveillance data based on quality indicators.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU integrates the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This completes the main flow by defining the action for new, uncorrelated tracks, ensuring they are added to the system picture.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict; (2) The two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local Mode II code is current; (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks; (4) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines mandatory system behavior during track correlation that constrains automatic processing — directly impacts the main flow by specifying when automatic correlation must be inhibited.

evidence_cards.content: Systems shall have an initialization parameter and an operator selectable capability to inhibit this automatic restriction for ID conflicts or differing Mode II codes, subject to interface coordination and promulgation to all C2 IUs.

evidence_cards.content: In lieu of specific interface direction, all IUs will restrict automatic correlation by default.
